metadata.title: Tropical Jungle Portrait with Vibrant Apparel

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man with a mustache, wearing a bright yellow floral shirt and a blue trucker hat, crouching in a dense, dark green jungle environment while holding a brown chicken. The lighting is moody and directional, emphasizing the subject against a deep, shadowed background of tropical leaves.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between the bright yellow shirt and the dark, cool-toned jungle foliage.
The subject's wary expression creates a narrative tension with the mundane act of holding a chicken.
The vertical rainbow border on the right edge provides a graphic, non-diegetic framing element.
coreInvariants: Dense, dark green tropical foliage background
Bright yellow short-sleeved floral button-down shirt
Blue trucker-style cap with a yellow rectangular patch
Subject holding a live brown chicken in the foreground

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centrally located, captured from the waist up in a crouching position, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's face and the bright yellow shirt serve as the primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the man's face, moves down to the yellow shirt, follows his arms to the chicken, and is finally framed by the vertical rainbow stripe on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark, textured foliage provides significant negative space that pushes the subject forward.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Magenta/pink (shorts) and the multi-colored rainbow border (red, orange, yellow, green, blue)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the clothing against low-value, desaturated greens in the background.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain deep, crushed blacks in the shadows

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are contained within a yellow rectangular border on the hat

composition.warp: Slightly curved to match hat contour

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single bold display face for the hat patch.
graphicDevices: Vertical rainbow stripe border on the right edge
Rectangular border around the hat text

preserve: Yellow-on-blue color scheme for the hat

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif and blocky construction.
Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic photo of a man with a mustache in a dark jungle, wearing a yellow floral shirt and a blue trucker hat, holding a brown chicken. Include a vertical rainbow stripe on the far right edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a yellow rectangular patch to the front of the blue hat containing bold, yellow slab-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the jungle background dark and moody?
Is the shirt a vibrant yellow with floral patterns?
Is the rainbow border present on the right edge?
Is the text on the hat a heavy slab serif?

adjustableVariables: Specific floral pattern on the shirt
mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on the hat or clothing
Transcribed text from the original image

mustAchieve: Rich color saturation in the subject's clothing
Naturalistic texture on the chicken's feathers
avoid: Overly bright or neon green foliage

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the chicken looks realistic and integrated into the man's hands.
Check that the lighting on the subject matches the environment.
Verify the rainbow border is a clean, vertical graphic element.
Confirm the hat text is legible and correctly styled as a slab serif.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-saturation subject in eccentric clothing with a low-key, monochromatic natural environment, framed by a minimalist graphic border.
